notes.title: Tutorial Update & Hotfixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! You may have noticed a few updates were sent out this week. Here is the change log for everything that was fixed/added.

- Added Tutorial/Guide at the start of the campaign
- Fixed re-calling units by selecting through the UI
- Fixed next-turn campaign button disappearing after losing first city and reloading campaign
- Fixed UI blocking issue for low resolution displays
- Performance Improvements when a large amount of rag dolls are on screen

If any bugs/complaints come up please make a report and I will address it ASAP.
With that being said, thank you all for a successful launch week!

notes.title: Vae Victis is now out!
notes.notes:
Excited to announce that Vae Victis is now out on steam! (1 day early)

If you find bugs, balancing problems, or need help please make a post in community discussions. I will be working around the clock to help!

Thanks to everyone who has supported the game! I hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Roadmap & Release Plans
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! With the excitement of the upcoming release I think it is an appropriate time to discuss the Release plan and road map for Vae Victis.

Also if anyone is interested I made an official guide that outlines Unit statistics, factions, battle calculations and more: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3012033422

[u]Release Plan[/u]
Release is slated for this week on August 4th! Although I don't expect many I'm sure someone will find at least one bug so the plan is to work on hot fixes around the clock for the first few days.
They will be prioritized as such:
-Game breaking bugs
-Multiplayer Exploits
-Highly prevalent bugs
-Single player Exploits

Multiplayer although thoroughly tested there are many edge cases that could have been missed, you should expect to be able to play through multiplayer games without a hitch but there might be some game breaking bugs or exploits (if you try hard enough). I will be working very hard to get these patched ASAP upon release.

Reporting bugs here will ensure I see them and I am able to fix them, expect bug fixes to be sent out within 24 hours during the first 2 weeks of launch (Dependent on severity): https://steamcommunity.com/app/2420820/discussions/0/


[u]Road Map[/u]
Although the game is completed I plan to add a few updates:

[b]Game Balancing[/b] will be the first planned update, this will be the first update which will happen once the community comes to a consensus on what seems over/under powered within the game.

[b]General Abilities[/b], currently there are only 3 abilities within the campaign I plan to expand this to 5 dependent on what is most heavily requested (you can make requests here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2420820/discussions/1/)


[b]Units[/b], I plan to add in 2 more units to the game, again this is dependent on what the community requests most.

[b]Factions[/b], currently there are no plans to add more factions however if requested I will plan to add more to the game.

Any additional functionality will be added if heavily requested. So please make those requests as I would like the expansion of the game to be community driven!

With that being said I hope you all enjoy the game, leave your feedback and I will try to address as much as possible!

notes.title: August 4th Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Release is coming up on August 4th so mark your calendars!

I'm excited to share that all feature implementations are complete including the Campaign, Multiplayer, and Custom Battles.

Multiplayer however may have edge cases upon release resulting in bugs or failures. However you should still expect to be able to play multiplayer games from start to finish. 

I will be rapidly working on hot-fixes during release. So please don't hesitate to report bugs if they are found. Regardless the current build of the game is stable, feature complete and ready for release!

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Multiplayer & Gore
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Won't go into way too much detail but some major progress with Vae Victis has been made!

[u][b]Multiplayer[/b][/u]
Multiplayer has been fully integrated with the steam networking api, meaning we were able to play a few PVP matches successfully over Steam! I originally anticipated this to take a lot more time then it did but the conversion from our original networking solution to the steamworks api was very simple to do. I also converted all of the netcode to align with changes made to the single player methods. Meaning if a change is made for single player, that change will translate over to multiplayer. So what does this mean? Release might be possible [b]way[/b] sooner then I originally thought. 

Small note, multiplayer isn't completely stable it still needs to be tested more thoroughly. However anyone can pick the game up and play multiplayer now.

[u][b]Gore[/b][/u]
The gore system for the game has been expanded to allow for crawling soldiers that leave blood trails, exploding body parts and more! [i]Don't worry, if you're squeamish there will be a way to disable this![/i]

Take a look below to check it out!

These are team specific special units that have a very high cost. They are basically your hero units that are very strong and have special abilities. A single one of these units could take on an army of regular units.

[b]Development timeline.[/b]
In short, I plan to release the game within the range of 8 to 15 months from today. Everything is subject to change so the release date is not concrete yet. I also have been looking into working with a publisher which may drastically alter our timeline. With that being said the game is in a very playable state right now and technically could be released as a barebones product, but that isn't the goal of this project.
